title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Settling an Agreement Account in One Payment
content:
## Owner's guide: paying the agreement account off

A building owner may settle their Preventive Maintenance Agreements account in one payment against the agreement, applied to the invoice they name. The payment is recorded with today as the day the office received it and lowers the amount owed under the agreement by the amount paid.

The settlement figure is fixed only after the balance carries the monthly charge that the instalments left unpaid past their due day have together earned. Before the settlement figure is worked out, the balance must carry the credit owed for every booked visit of the term that went unperformed past its rebooking window. The settlement figure is not taken until the balance carries the price of every visit performed beyond the visits the term credited.

### How the payment is made

The agent unlocks the customer's own tool `record_agreement_settlement_0349d2fc` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it. One call books a single payment from the owner against the named agreement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record the payment is applied to | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `invoice_ref` | the invoice number the payment is applied to, copied from an instalment entry in the agreement's history | `INV-` followed by 8 digits |
| `settlement_amount_usd` | the money amount the owner pays | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and books a zero payment |
| `payment_method` | how the owner sent the money, one of exactly four values | `check` — a paper cheque drawn on the company account, posted or handed over; `ach` — money pushed by bank transfer from the owner's own bank; `credit_card` — the payment put on a company credit card; `wire` — money sent by same-day wire transfer |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the payment entry created, the agreement it was applied to, the invoice it was applied against, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places and the way the money was sent. That line is issued only when the payment has been written and the agreement's outstanding balance has been lowered; it is the owner's receipt of completion.
